player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Dining room and the Pantry, repeatedly going west and then east without exploring other potential paths. I prematurely declared "DONE" while assuming all rooms were visited. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms and only say "DONE" when the number of unique rooms visited equals the total number of rooms I have encountered. If I return to a room I've already visited, I will check if there are any unvisited neighbors before deciding to stop. Specifically, from the Pantry, instead of immediately going back east, I should have checked if "west" leads to a new room or if there are other directions available that I haven't tried yet.
